notes.text: The Yerushalmi names Chuna as the sukkah visitor, while Rav Yehudah belongs to the surrounding roster. In Berakhot 2:1 the chain begins with Chuna and then lists Uri, Yosef and Yehudah in Shmuel’s name. Shimon Kamtarya appears with Chuna in Shmuel bar Nachman’s name in a separate Berakhot passage. Preserve the reported reverse transmission, the uncertain identity and the unmatched locators as such.
